title: Multi-Reward Hacking: From Aggregation-Induced Drift to Trust-Anchored Defense
abstract: arXiv:2610.21404v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To improve task performance while encouraging desirable response properties, LLM post-training often combines a primary reward (e.g., correctness) with auxiliary rewards (e.g., brevity or efficiency). However, how these rewards are aggregated can critically affect training outcomes. We show that symmetric aggregation, which treats reward channels equally, can induce a failure where aggregate reward improves while primary-task performance degrades, even when individual rewards are meaningful. We investigate this aggregation-induced failure through a one-step multi-reward decision formulation, characterizing when it constitutes multi-reward hacking. We prove that, under symmetric aggregation, deterministic conditional-mean GRPO converges to auxiliary-favoring behavior when auxiliary rewards are more reliably obtained, regardless of initialization. translated_title: 多奖励破解：从聚合诱导漂移到信任锚定防御
translated_abstract: 为了在提升任务性能的同时鼓励理想的响应特性，大语言模型（LLM）后训练通常将主要奖励（如正确性）与辅助奖励（如简洁性或效率）相结合。然而，这些奖励的聚合方式会显著影响训练结果。我们证明，对称聚合（即平等对待各个奖励通道）可能引发一种失效模式：即使各单项奖励本身是有意义的，聚合奖励仍会提升，而主任务性能却在下降。我们通过一步式多奖励决策形式化来研究这种由聚合诱导的失效，并刻画了其何时构成多奖励破解。我们证明，在对称聚合下，当辅助奖励更容易被可靠获得时，确定性的条件均值GRPO无论初始化如何都会收敛到偏向辅助奖励的行为。我们提出信任锚定门控（TAG），首先基于……选出锚定通道（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 论文揭示了对称聚合多奖励会引发“多奖励破解”现象——即聚合奖励提升而主任务性能反而下降，并证明了确定性条件均值GRPO在辅助奖励更易获得时必然收敛到偏向辅助的行为，同时提出信任锚定门控（TAG）作为防御方法。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that symmetric aggregation of multiple rewards can induce "multi-reward hacking," where aggregate reward improves while primary-task performance degrades, proves that deterministic conditional-mean GRPO converges to auxiliary-favoring behavior regardless of initialization, and proposes Trust-Anchored Gating (TAG) as a defense against this failure mode.
